A man with glasses and a gray hoodie appears in the lower frame, looking around the bustling street. (3) The camera pans to show the man's feet walking on a patterned sidewalk, mirrored by animated legs at the top. Crowds of people are visible in the background of the real-world street. (4) A bright, rainbow-colored flash transition occurs. The man looks up with an expression of pure joy and amazement, his mouth wide open. The top animation mirrors this with its main character looking up at the Tsutenkaku Tower against a bright blue sky.
